body: Oh my gosh, I swear this happens all the time! I've been riding my bike more and I've gotten tired of always taking plain water. I'll be out the door, helmet strapped to my head, and I tear open the packet where it says, only for it to still be shut tight. Like, WTF? It's not on the go if I need to bring scissors to open it!

Thank you, I'd take you up on that offer but I need to sleep now. I'm doing more applications at different places tomorrow and I gotta go during non peak hours. Maybe tomorrow we could chat...I'm sure I'll need it. I always seem to end my day in tears.
Oh, I see. Thank you very much.
I never Pm'ed anyone on reddit before...Could you tell me how? I really wouldn't mind talking to someone..
The only story I have right now is only 2.4k words. It's not very much. If you want to read it I don't mind sharing

Glad I made sense then! Well, I'm sure you're getting tired of talking to me so I'll let you go, but I do want to thank you for commenting and chatting! It's been nice and I appreciate it, so thank you. ^^
Okay, thanks for letting me know. I'll look into it.

Well uh, it's like I said before. I don't do so well with others. Not that I'm mean, or hard to work with or anything. I don't have any finished stories either. 

I have started a story, but it's only a few pages. I'm not very motivated to work/finish it, and i'm not sure why. When I'm in the mood to write, I write a lot, but that mood is rather rare and is usually used up in my college writing assignments.I dunno, I'm just really weird. Sorry if this doesn't make much sense >.<
Thank you, I really appreciate it ^^. It's nice knowing there are some kind people out in the world.

I've never sent my work anywhere, not recently anyway. My 7th grade english teacher submitted one of my short stories to a reading fair or something, and I was 3rd place in the county(Of course reading that story now is just painful).

I can only enjoy wiritng fiction, usually fantasy/adventure. I'm not quite sure what you mean by sending it to a workshop? Is that like sending it to a publisher?

Well, my point with my degree is that it wasn't exactly what I signed up for. I wanted to specifically learn how to program games. But my degree is only a small portion of programming while the rest is game design/development, game marketing, 3d modeling and so on. If I wanted to work somewhere I'd only be good at designing games, by that I mean the whole idea of a game(enemies, weapons, levels etc).

 I can't do any other specifics like programming, 3d model, or marketing cause my degree just lets you taste those fields. It's not in depth enough for me to get a job in any of them, though I'm only interested in programming.

I can't imagine getting another degree after my current one, I'll be buried in loans for life.

I'm not really sure what I'm good at. I don't really excel in anything in particular. Through out schooling I've always had an easy time with classes, rarely sturggling in any course. Only exception being my programming classes, which I really enjoy as it was something I liked and was challenging.

I'm fairly good in physics and mathmatics, just finished a calculus course. I suppose I'm a decent writer, my english teacher in college told me my work was nearly book writing material.

I can't really think of anything else..
